text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 36 vials of plerixafor 24 mg/1.2 mL, providing 8.4 days on hand at 4.3 vials per day. Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC was posted as To Be Discontinued on 2026-03-13 with a business decision to discontinue manufacture.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include plerixafor as of 2026-10-21. Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC was posted as To Be Discontinued on 2026-03-13 with a business decision to discontinue manufacture.

Our position: Current inventory covers 8.4 days. Five alternate manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list today. None of their labels name a plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. supply and pricing; P&T committee must approve addition to formulary.
2. Buyer to evaluate Gland Pharma Limited supply and pricing; P&T committee must approve addition to formulary.
3. Buyer to evaluate Novadoz Pharmaceuticals LLC supply and pricing; P&T committee must approve addition to formulary.
4. Buyer to evaluate Sagent Pharmaceuticals supply and pricing; P&T committee must approve addition to formulary.
5. Buyer to evaluate Sanofi-Aventis U.S. LLC supply and pricing; P&T committee must approve addition to formulary.

Not recommended: Delay procurement beyond current days on hand; rely on Fresenius Kabi supply after discontinuation posting.
